symbols.name: ICapturePostProcessor
symbols.description: Required contract for a post-processing plugin. CyCapture discovers concrete implementations from DLL files in the current user's Plugins directory.

symbols.name: ICapturePostProcessor.ProcessAsync
symbols.description: Runs after the capture file has been finalized. A plugin should leave the original file usable if processing fails and should honor cancellation when practical.

parameters.name: artifact
parameters.description: Completed capture and its selection metadata.

parameters.name: cancellationToken
parameters.description: Token signaled when CyCapture is shutting down or cancels the pipeline.

symbols.returns: A task that completes when post-processing has finished.

symbols.name: ICapturePluginMetadata
symbols.description: Optional metadata and configuration contract. It supplies the description, default state, quick-access label and generated settings shown by CyCapture.

symbols.name: ICapturePluginHostAware.InitializeHost
symbols.description: Optional initialization callback that provides the plugin with CyCapture's per-user data directory.

parameters.name: dataDirectory
parameters.description: Absolute path to the current user's CyCapture data directory.

symbols.name: ICapturePluginPreparable.PrepareAsync
symbols.description: Optional background preparation performed after CyCapture starts, before the first completed capture is sent to the plugin.

parameters.name: cancellationToken
parameters.description: Token signaled when application shutdown cancels preparation.

symbols.returns: A task that completes when the plugin is ready.

symbols.name: CapturePluginSettingDefinition
symbols.signature: public sealed record CapturePluginSettingDefinition(string Key, string Label, CapturePluginSettingKind Kind, string DefaultValue = "", IReadOnlyList<string>? Choices = null)
symbols.description: Describes one setting rendered automatically in the CyCapture Settings window. Supported kinds are Text, Boolean and Choice.

parameters.name: Kind
parameters.description: Editor type: Text, Boolean or Choice.

parameters.name: DefaultValue
parameters.description: Value used when no user setting exists.

parameters.name: Choices
parameters.description: Allowed values for a Choice field.

symbols.name: CaptureArtifact
symbols.signature: public sealed record CaptureArtifact(string Path, CaptureMode Mode, CaptureSelection Selection, DateTimeOffset StartedAt, DateTimeOffset FinishedAt)
symbols.description: Immutable description of a finalized image, video, GIF or audio capture passed to post-processors.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: Absolute path to the completed media file.

parameters.name: Selection
parameters.description: Selected visual bounds; audio uses an empty selection descriptor.

symbols.name: CaptureSelection
symbols.signature: public sealed record CaptureSelection(PixelBounds Bounds, MonitorDescriptor Monitor, SelectionKind Kind, string Title, nint WindowHandle = 0, byte[]? FrozenFramePng = null, QuickAnnotationDocument? QuickAnnotations = null)
symbols.description: The target chosen for a visual capture, including desktop coordinates, monitor information and optional frozen-frame annotations.

symbols.name: CaptureMode
symbols.signature: public enum CaptureMode { Image, Video, Gif, Audio }
symbols.description: Identifies the four capture pipelines available to users and plugins.
